name: Maule Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

known.via: English Wikipedia "Maule Valley" (a wine place on Wikidata)

notes: Maule is Chile's largest wine region, and its Carmenère is notably spicy, with black pepper.
Old Carignan vines give soft, earthy reds with rich plum and black fruit.
Newer plantings of Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Carmenère show bright acidity and juicy fruit.

blurb.text: A subregion at the southern end of Chile's Central Valley. Cabernet Sauvignon covers 28 percent of vines, followed by Sauvignon Blanc at 14 percent and País at 11 percent.
